snippet.title: Colony Ship - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Colony Ship coming to Steam and GoG on November 9th 2023.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/648410/Colony_Ship_A_PostEarth_Role_Playing_Game/

https://www.gog.com/en/game/colony_ship_a_postearth_role_playing_game


Colony Ship is a turn-based, party-based RPG set aboard a generation ship launched to Proxima Centauri. The game features a detailed skill-based character system, multiple ways to handle quests, choices & consequences, and branching dialogue trees.
